_comment: Stock materials for tools/cad recipes (LLF-69). parts[].material names a key here. densityKgM3 drives manifest massKg/inertia; pbr is passed to cad_export_body.materialsOverride as {name, pbrMetallicRoughness:pbr}. Add a stock here (with a source) before using it in a recipe. 'effective-*' stocks are for parts modelled solid that are really hollow assemblies: their density is the spec-sheet weight divided by the modelled volume.

effective-light-aircraft-airframe.source: LLF-81: class empty weight 767 kg (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cessna_172, 172S) minus prop 15 kg, gear legs 40 kg, tyres 24 kg = 688 kg spread over the 8.728 m^3 modelled solid airframe + control surfaces (skin, structure, engine and cabin are inside the solid envelope)

effective-light-aircraft-controls.source: LLF-81: same effective density as effective-light-aircraft-airframe; red trim finish for the moving surfaces

effective-fixed-pitch-prop.source: LLF-81: ~15 kg 75 in forged-aluminium fixed-pitch prop (assumed typical for the class) / 0.01368 m^3 modelled blade envelope

effective-spring-steel-gear.source: LLF-81: ~40 kg for two main legs + nose strut (assumed) / 0.1014 m^3 modelled leg envelopes

effective-aircraft-tire.source: LLF-81: ~24 kg for 2 x 15x6.00 main + 1 x 5.00-5 nose wheel/tyre assemblies (assumed) / 0.04287 m^3 modelled discs

a380-diecast-grey.source: A380 die-casting alloy 2.71 g/cc (NADCA); grey powder-coat finish

effective-cobra-head-luminaire.source: 50 lb (22.7 kg) cobra-head luminaire (shineretrofits 20 ft pole listing) / 0.02912 m^3 modelled housing envelope

ductile-iron-red.source: ASTM A536 ductile iron 7.1 g/cc; red enamel hydrant finish

bronze.source: C83600 leaded red brass/bronze 8.83 g/cc (AWWA C502 operating-nut material)

pine.source: USDA Wood Handbook FPL-GTR-190 Table 5-3a: southern pine ~0.51 specific gravity at 12% MC

oak.source: USDA Wood Handbook: red oak ~0.63-0.75 g/cc at 12% MC

robot-cast-alu.source: effective density (LLF-74): cast-aluminium robot housings with gearboxes inside, modelled solid. 190 kg arm (evsint.com EV10-1450 sheet) minus ~25 kg servos = 164.5 kg over 0.0868 m^3 of modelled castings

robot-cast-orange.source: same effective casting density as robot-cast-alu; generic industrial orange paint (no brand colour match)

servo-motor-black.source: effective density (LLF-74): ~25 kg of AC servo motors (typical 1-3 kW frame ~6-10 kg each) over 0.00422 m^3 modelled motor envelopes

safety-yellow-steel.source: AISI 1018 7.87 g/cc, safety-yellow powder coat (machine-guard posts, ISO 3864 signal yellow)

powder-black-steel.source: AISI 1018 7.87 g/cc, black powder-coated guard panels

letter-foam.source: ASTM C578 Type XI expanded polystyrene, 0.70 pcf = 11.2 kg/m^3 (the light EPS of foam toy letters). Typed letters use it at runtime (src/core/glyphs.js DENSITY.foam); spelled words use Type VIII 18.4 kg/m^3.

ductile-iron-blue.source: ASTM A536 ductile iron 7.1 g/cc; AWWA C550-style blue waterworks coating

steel-zinc-8.8.source: ISO 898-1 class 8.8 carbon steel 7.85 g/cc, zinc plated

carbon-steel-pipe.source: EN 10255 / ISO 65 medium-series carbon steel tube 7.85 g/cc, painted grey-blue

effective-c57-body.source: JNR C57 engine weight 67.5 t (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JNR_Class_C57) minus the steel motion set and steel chassis parts, divided by the 45.7 m^3 envelope modelled solid (frame, boiler, cab, cylinders, steam chests)

effective-c57-tender.source: C57 tender in working order 48 t (115.5 t total minus 67.5 t engine, en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JNR_Class_C57) minus steel bogies/wheels/underframe and the coal load, over the 35.6 m^3 tank modelled solid (water + plate)

coal.source: Bituminous coal bulk density ~830 kg/m^3 (engineeringtoolbox.com bulk material densities)

effective-coach-body.source: 33 t tare (assumed Suha 43 class figure) minus steel bogies/wheels/underframe, roof and glass, over the 110.2 m^3 body box modelled solid; JNR grape-brown (budo-iro) paint

effective-coach-roof.source: Painted canvas on timber roof boards over carlines, modelled as a solid arch: ~2.2 t roof (assumed) / 14.9 m^3

effective-underframe.source: Riveted steel channel underframe modelled as a solid slab: ~6 t for a 20 m coach (assumed) / 12.4 m^3

effective-bogie-frame.source: TR23 bogie (weblio.jp/content/TR23) less its wheels, ~2.4 t (assumed), modelled as a 3200 x 940 x 270 mm block

ballast-granite.source: Crushed granite track ballast bulk density ~1.6-1.8 t/m^3 (AREMA ballast guidance)

creosoted-timber.source: Creosote-treated hardwood/pine sleeper ~0.8 g/cc (USDA Wood Handbook + preservative retention)

hinoki-vermilion.source: Hinoki (Chamaecyparis obtusa) 0.41 g/cc air-dry (Wood Database); shu (vermilion) lacquer finish

lantern-firebox.source: Granite fire box of the stone lantern (scene lights its emissive at NIGHT / LANTERN)

effective-pagoda-body.source: Timber-framed pagoda storey modelled solid: ~250 kg/m^3 effective (assumed: ~300 t pagoda over ~1100 m^3 envelope)

kawara-roof.source: Kawara clay tiles on timber roof framing modelled as solid lofts: ~400 kg/m^3 effective (assumed)

keyaki-door.source: Keyaki (Zelkova serrata) 0.69 g/cc (Wood Database); palace gate door leaves

roof-sheet-green.source: Painted corrugated steel canopy on purlins modelled as a solid gable: ~300 kg/m^3 effective (assumed)

effective-bus-body.source: 7 t small bus kerb weight (Isuzu Journey class) less wheels, over the 31.7 m^3 body box modelled solid; kindergarten yellow

effective-machiya-body.source: Timber-framed machiya with plaster walls modelled as solid storey boxes: ~150 kg/m^3 effective (assumed: ~20 t house over ~250 m^3)

cast-iron-black.source: ASTM A48 grey cast iron 7.1 g/cc; black powder-coat

car-paint-blue.source: effective density: steel shell + interior + drivetrain ~1250 kg (assumed mid-size sedan curb weight ~1.45 t incl. wheels/glass) spread over the 3.9 m^3 solid body envelope; blue metallic paint

effective-bench-frame.source: cast-iron end frame modelled as solid 40 mm plates; real open-web frame is ~30 kg for the 0.0195 m^3 envelope (typical 6 ft commercial bench ~45 kg total incl. oak slats), so effective density 30 kg / 0.01952 m^3

effective-signal-arm.source: 100 mm box mast arm modelled solid (0.031 m^3); real hollow box section + cabling ~40 kg, so 40 kg / 0.031 m^3

effective-signal-head.source: 3-section 12 in polycarbonate/LED head ~15 kg (catalogue norm, assumed) over the 0.099 m^3 housing envelope

effective-glasshouse.source: glass + pillars ~40 kg (assumed) over the 1.58 m^3 modelled glasshouse envelope

effective-wheel.source: tyre + alloy wheel ~20 kg (205/55R16, assumed) over the 0.064 m^3 modelled cylinder

effective-tower-white.source: masonry lighthouse tower, white lime-wash; 0.6 m shell is ~25% of the solid envelope (brick ~2000 kg/m^3 x 0.3)

effective-tower-red.source: masonry lighthouse tower, red daymark band; same effective density as the white bands

effective-water-tank.source: oak-stave tank (hollow, ~0.1 m shell) over the 37.7 m^3 modelled cylinder: ~40% of a full 20 kgal tank is dead weight in the structure; effective density 300

effective-lattice-steel.source: galvanised angle legs modelled solid; real 30 ft windmill tower ~900 kg total incl. bracing, so effective density 2500 kg/m^3 over the modelled leg/plate envelope

effective-rotor.source: 8 ft multi-blade galvanised wheel ~180 kg (assumed from catalogue sheets) over the modelled star envelope

effective-lrv-alu.source: LRV 6061 aluminium tube chassis ~210 kg unladen (NSSDC) spread over modelled chassis/seat envelope

effective-lrv-battery.source: LRV silver-zinc battery module ~36 kg (assumed) over the 0.25 m^3 modelled box

effective-wire-wheel.source: LRV wire-mesh wheel ~5.4 kg (assumed) over the 0.121 m^3 modelled cylinder

effective-dish-alu.source: 12 mm aluminium reflector shell modelled as a solid paraboloid skin; ~300 kg for a 3 m dish (assumed)

sign-white-alu.source: LLF-103: aluminium sign blank 2.70 g/cc, white sheeting

sign-red-alu.source: LLF-103: 3003 aluminium sign blank 2.70 g/cc (ASM), red retroreflective sheeting finish

effective-shelter-frame.source: LLF-103: extruded-aluminium posts and a sheet roof on purlins modelled as solid boxes; ~6 kg per 60 mm post and ~150 kg roof (assumed catalogue norms) over the modelled volume
